name: food-order-platform
description: Two isolated microservices (Restaurant + Order), a React admin console, PostgreSQL and pgAdmin.

scripts.install:all: npm --prefix services/restaurant install && npm --prefix services/order install && npm --prefix web install
scripts.build:all: npm --prefix services/restaurant run build && npm --prefix services/order run build && npm --prefix web run build
scripts.test: npm --prefix services/restaurant test && npm --prefix services/order test
